# Supermetrics MCP

> Supermetrics MCP is a remote Model Context Protocol server that gives AI agents live access to
> marketing performance data from 174 advertising, analytics, e-commerce and CRM platforms, plus
> read-write campaign management and live dashboard publishing. This repository contains the public
> listing manifests and install configurations — the server itself is hosted by Supermetrics.

Server URL: https://mcp.supermetrics.com/mcp (streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.0, DCR and CIMD supported)

A Supermetrics account with a 14-day free trial is created automatically on first login.

## What it does

- Query live marketing data across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Microsoft
  Advertising, Amazon Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Shopify, HubSpot, Salesforce,
  Klaviyo, Stripe and 160+ other platforms.
- Discover data sources, accounts, report types, fields, metrics and dimensions before querying.
- Create, update, pause and audit ad campaigns on Google, Meta, Microsoft, TikTok, LinkedIn and
  ChatGPT Ads, including ad groups, ads, targeting and creatives.
- Publish live, shareable dashboards to Supermetrics Studio that re-query data on every view.
- Store team reporting conventions as business context and apply them consistently across sessions.

## Tools

supermetrics_guide, data_source_discovery, accounts_discovery, field_discovery, data_query,
get_async_query_results, get_today, manage_business_context, campaign_and_resource_get,
manage_campaign, manage_dashboards, resources_manage, manage_user_and_team, contact_supermetrics

## Install

- Claude and ChatGPT: available as a ready-made connector in the app directory.
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http supermetrics https://mcp.supermetrics.com/mcp`
- Codex: `codex plugin marketplace add supermetrics/supermetrics-mcp`
- Gemini CLI: `gemini extensions install https://github.com/supermetrics/supermetrics-mcp`
- Antigravity: `agy plugin install https://github.com/supermetrics/supermetrics-mcp`
- Cursor, VS Code, Zed, Windsurf, Cline, n8n: point the client at the server URL over streamable HTTP.
